controller.title: Data controller
controller.name: MEGA PARKING
controller.contactText: For any question about your personal data, or to exercise your rights, write to info@megaparking.gr or send a letter to the company address.

authority.title: Right to lodge a complaint
authority.text: If you believe the processing of your data infringes the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679, you may lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
authority.name: Hellenic Data Protection Authority

meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How MEGA Parking collects, uses and protects your personal data.

privacy.lead: This page explains which of your data we process, why, for how long, and how you can exercise your rights.
privacy.rightsIntro: The General Data Protection Regulation gives you specific rights. You can exercise them free of charge, at any time.

meta.title: Terms of service
meta.description: The terms under which you use the MEGA Parking website and services.

terms.lead: By using our website and services you accept the terms below.

meta.title: Cookies
meta.description: What each cookie category does and how to change your choices.

cookies.lead: Cookies are small files stored on your device. The necessary ones keep the site working; everything else is your decision.
cookies.manageText: You can change your choices at any time. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.description: Without these the site does not work: login session, form security, and your cookie choice itself. They require no consent (Art. 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC).
necessary.examples: Examples: user session, cross-site request forgery protection, storing your cookie preferences.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.description: They show us anonymously which pages are read and where you struggle, so we can improve the site.
analytics.examples: Examples: traffic measurement, entry and exit pages, time on site.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.description: They let us show you relevant ads and measure how those ads perform on third-party platforms.

banner.title: We respect your choices
banner.description: We use necessary cookies to keep the site running. With your consent we also use analytics and marketing cookies. You can change your mind at any time.
banner.settingsDescription: Choose which cookie categories you allow. Necessary cookies are always on.

consentCheckbox.contact: I have read the privacy policy and consent to my details being processed so that you can reply to my message.
consentCheckbox.proposal: I have read the privacy policy and consent to my details being processed so that you can prepare and send me a quote.
consentCheckbox.required: We need your consent in order to continue.

meta.title: Your rights
meta.description: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection and withdrawal of consent.

dataRights.lead: Your data is yours. Below we explain what you can ask for, and you can submit your request in a minute.

ACCESS.title: Access
ACCESS.description: Find out whether we process your data and receive a copy, together with the purpose, the recipients and the retention period.

RECTIFICATION.title: Rectification
RECTIFICATION.description: Have inaccurate details corrected or incomplete ones completed — a wrong phone number or licence plate, for example.

ERASURE.title: Erasure
ERASURE.description: Have your data deleted when we no longer need it, or when you withdraw consent and no other legal basis applies.

RESTRICTION.title: Restriction
RESTRICTION.description: Freeze the processing — for instance while the accuracy of your data or the merit of an objection is being checked.

PORTABILITY.title: Portability
PORTABILITY.description: Receive the data you gave us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

OBJECTION.title: Objection
OBJECTION.description: Object to processing based on legitimate interest, and at any time to direct marketing.

WITHDRAW.title: Withdrawal of consent
WITHDRAW.description: Withdraw consent you have given, as easily as you gave it. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand.

form.title: Submit a request
form.description: Fill in the form. We will email you a confirmation link — that is how we make sure the request really comes from you.
form.emailHint: Use the address you contacted us with — the confirmation link will be sent there.
form.messagePlaceholder: Anything that helps us find your records (optional)
form.consent: I consent to the details in this form being processed solely in order to handle my request.
form.successDescription: We sent you an email with a confirmation link. We reply within one month of confirmation at the latest.
form.errorDescription: The request was not submitted. Please try again or write to info@megaparking.gr.

errors.type: Choose which right you want to exercise.
errors.name: Enter your full name.
errors.consent: We need your consent in order to continue.

verified.title: Your request is confirmed
verified.description: We have started working on it. You will hear from us within one month at the latest.

verifyFailed.title: This link is not valid
verifyFailed.description: The confirmation link is wrong or has already been used. Submit a new request or write to info@megaparking.gr.

dataRights.deadlineText: We reply without undue delay and within one month of the request being confirmed at the latest (Art. 12(3)). For complex requests that period may be extended by two months — we will tell you if it is.
dataRights.freeText: Exercising your rights costs you nothing.
